gitNova.showRemoteBranches.description: Show remote branches in tree view

pattern.description: Regular expression matched against commit message text

url.description: URL template. Supports $1..$9 capture groups and {owner}/{repo} placeholders resolved from the detected GitHub remote

gitNova.autolinks.description: Autolink rules applied to commit messages wherever they are rendered (commit graph, tooltips, blame hovers)

gitNova.blame.format.description: Template for inline blame annotations. Placeholders: {{author}}, {{email}}, {{commit}}, {{summary}}, {{date}}

gitNova.blame.recentDays.description: Number of days to consider a commit 'recent'

gitNova.blame.statusBar.description: Show blame for the current line in the status bar

isRegex.description: Treat the pattern as a regular expression

requirePullRequest.description: Warn when committing directly to matching branches

requireLinearHistory.description: Require linear history on matching branches

requireSignedCommits.description: Require signed commits on matching branches

gitNova.branchProtection.rules.description: Custom branch protection rules (empty uses the built-in defaults for main/master/develop/release/hotfix)

gitNova.branchNaming.requireTicketNumber.description: Require ticket number in branch name

gitNova.branchNaming.ticketPattern.description: Regex pattern for ticket numbers in branch names

gitNova.commitMessage.maxBodyLineLength.description: Maximum commit body line length before a warning

gitNova.commitMessage.requireScope.description: Require a scope in conventional commit messages: type(scope): description

gitNova.ai.enabled.description: Enable AI-assisted features (commit message generation, commit/change explanations)

enumDescriptions: Use the built-in VS Code Language Model API (GitHub Copilot or any installed chat model). No API key required.
Anthropic (Claude) via the Messages API. Requires an Anthropic API key.
OpenAI Chat Completions (Azure OpenAI auto-detected from the base URL). Requires an OpenAI API key.
Google Gemini. Requires a Gemini API key.
Any OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint (Ollama, LM Studio, Groq, OpenRouter, Mistral, xAI, DeepSeek, GLM, …).
gitNova.ai.provider.description: Which AI provider GitNova should use for AI features. Use 'GitNova: Select AI Model' for a guided picker.

gitNova.ai.preset.description: Preset used to prefill the OpenAI-compatible base URL (informational; set via the model picker)

gitNova.ai.maxTokens.description: Maximum output tokens per AI request

gitNova.ai.azureApiVersion.description: api-version query parameter used when the OpenAI base URL points at Azure OpenAI

gitNova.ai.vscodeModelFamily.description: Preferred model family for the VS Code provider (e.g. 'gpt-4o', 'claude-3.5-sonnet'). Leave empty to use the first available model.

gitNova.ai.baseUrl.description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible provider (e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama)

gitNova.ai.model.description: Model id for the OpenAI-compatible provider (e.g. 'gpt-4o-mini', 'llama3.1')

gitNova.ai.conventionalCommits.description: Ask the AI to produce Conventional Commits-formatted messages

gitNova.codeLens.enabled.description: Show inline Git CodeLens authorship annotations above files and code blocks

gitNova.codeLens.showFileAuthors.description: Show a file-level CodeLens with the most recent change and author count

gitNova.codeLens.showSymbols.description: Show a CodeLens above functions, methods and classes with their most recent change

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
